sections.text: Two-part oracle for `nucleide.plasma_source`: analytic gates P1-P4 on the synthetic ring spec (closed-form ring/spectrum moments, sampler determinism, card emission), P5-P7 on a parametric Miller-geometry plasma (flat-profile Jacobian closed forms, Bosch-Hale reactivity transcription, sampled moments vs fine quadrature), P8 on a pinned 70/30 D/T fuel blend (mixture-rule moments and the D-D branch share vs in-script mixture quadrature), and P9 on the D(d,p)T proton bookkeeping (exact pure-fuel ratios, the 70/30 share, the no-T recovery anchor, the loud pure-T error), and P10 on toroidal sectors (in-sector uniform births, bit-for-bit full-rotation recovery, the PHI=D4 marginal with its drift row), and P11 on per-species ion temperatures (pair-temperature moments and branch share, bit-for-bit equal-T recovery, plus the single-fuel pair arms at the same landed temperatures with their own equal-T recovery), and P12 on the arbitrary-3D birth-rate lattice (hand-vector totals and means, single-point recovery, ring-limit closure, symmetry-fold replication, card round trip, mixture branch fire), and P13 on the deuterium hot-tail fraction (sub-rate-rule moments and branch share, the drift tail-neutron share, zero-fraction recovery) — always run — plus container-only cross-checks O1-O13 against the upstream openmc-plasma-source package and NeSST (Ballabio helpers, sampled ring/point sources, Miller map, Fausser profiles, reactivities, end-to-end parametric moments, the pinned 70/30 blend, the tritium-rich 10/90 T-T divergence probe, the partial-sector moment cross-check, the distinct-temperature blend probe, the lattice ring-limit probe, and the hot-tail blend probe; protons have no oracle — upstream models neutrons only).
P1 ring sampling: n=200000, radius min/max 300.000000/300.000000 cm.
P2 spectrum moments vs in-script Ballabio 1998 Table III transcription.
P4 Serpent drift rows are analytic by design (no reader in the workspace).
P5 flat-profile closed forms at delta=0: <r^2> = a^2/2, <z> = 0, and the outboard volume bias <R> = R0 + a^2/(4 R0) (volume element R|J|).
P6 reactivity <sigma v> vs in-script Bosch-Hale/Atzeni transcription.
P7 H-mode sampled moments vs fine quadrature of S·R·|J| (in-script Fausser/Bosch-Hale transcription), n=200000.

P8 70/30 D/T blend (fuel dict) vs in-script mixture quadrature (S = n^2·[f_D·f_T·<sv>_DT + (f_D^2/2)·<sv>_DD], Eriksson/DRESS rate rule), n=200000; the D-D branch share gate proves both Ballabio lines fire in the sampled stream.

P9 D(d,p)T proton bookkeeping (pinned 50/50 with the D-D neutron branch; sampler and cards stay neutron-only): exact pure-fuel ratios, the 70/30 share vs the P8 quadrature (tolerance is the 256-vs-400 grid precision on the H-mode pedestal kink — exactness is pinned by the crate hand vectors), the no-T recovery anchor, and the loud pure-T error.

P10 toroidal sector (start 0.5 rad, rotation 1.5 rad): uniform birth angles over the sector (n=200000), bit-for-bit full-rotation recovery of the landed kernel (stream and cards), and the PHI=D4 angle-bin marginal with its drift row.

P11b single-fuel pair (T_D=20 keV, T_T=30 keV, n=200000): single-fuel D-T reacts at T_DT=24 keV (mean 14.077934372230146 MeV) and single-fuel D-D at T_D (sampled moments vs the uniform-reactivity quadrature); the equal pair on a flat 20 keV single-fuel plasma recovers the shared kernel bit-for-bit (stream and cards, D-T and D-D).

P11 per-species ion temperatures (T_D=20 keV, T_T=30 keV, 70/30 blend, n=200000): D-T reacts at T_DT=24 keV, D-D at T_D (sampled moments and branch share vs the pair-temperature quadrature); the uniform equal pair on a flat 20 keV plasma recovers the shared kernel bit-for-bit (stream and cards).

sections.text: P12 arbitrary-3D birth-rate lattice: two-point hand vectors (total 3, mean x 100 cm, mono 14.021 MeV), single-point bit-for-bit recovery of the landed point source, ring-limit moment closure (n=200000), 4-period symmetry-fold replication with period-scaled totals, card round trip with the lattice drift row, and 70/30 mixture branch fire.

P13 deuterium hot tail (70/30 blend, T_D=20 keV, T_T=30 keV, eta=0.05 at T_tail=60 keV, n=200000): sampled moments and D-D branch share vs the sub-rate-rule quadrature, the card drift tail-neutron share vs the same quadrature, bit-for-bit zero-fraction recovery of the no-tail kernel (stream and cards), and loud tail errors.
O1 compares the Rust coefficient transcription against the upstream package's Table III helpers at three ion temperatures.
O2 D-D sampled moments at T_i=20 keV, n=200000 per side (upstream space object sampled analytically where OpenMC exposes no sampler).
O3 geometry cross-check uses the upstream ring's own CylindricalIndependent parameters (r delta, z delta, uniform azimuth) against Nucleide's sampled ring.
O4 forward map R(a,θ), Z(a,θ) (Shafranov shift included) at a 4×5 grid.
O5 Fausser L/H density and temperature profiles at seven radii (keV/eV converted).
O6 Bosch-Hale reactivity vs NeSST (tolerance 1e-6 reflects the published coefficients' precision, not the implementation).
O7 end-to-end parametric moments vs quadrature over the upstream map/profiles with the NeSST D-T reactivity, n=200000.
O8 70/30 D/T blend vs quadrature over the upstream map/profiles with NeSST reac_DT + reac_DD under the mixture rule, n=200000 (upstream T-T branch excluded — no T-T reaction in Nucleide).

O9 10/90 D/T blend, n=200000: sampled mean birth energy sits on the two-branch upstream quadrature (no T-T on either side) while the three-branch reference (NeSST reac_TT x2 multiplicity + Brune continuum mean ~4.6 MeV) pulls away by the T-T-predicted 0.371 MeV (TT neutron share 0.0393); measured pull 0.372 MeV.

O10 partial toroidal sector (start 0.5 rad, rotation 1.5 rad), n=200000: (r, z, E) moments sit on the O7 upstream quadrature (the sector only remaps the toroidal draw) and birth angles are uniform over the sector.

O11 70/30 D/T blend at T_D=20 keV, T_T=30 keV (D-T at T_DT=24 keV, D-D at T_D), n=200000: sampled moments vs quadrature over the upstream map/profiles with NeSST reac_DT + reac_DD evaluated at the pair temperatures.

O12 lattice ring limit (360-node monoenergetic cloud, n=200000): radius and azimuth moments vs the upstream ring CylindricalIndependent parameters, mean birth energy vs the upstream Ballabio mean helper.

O13 70/30 D/T blend with a 5% deuterium hot tail at T_tail=60 keV (T_D=20 keV, T_T=30 keV, n=200000): sampled moments vs quadrature over the upstream map/profiles with NeSST reac_DT + reac_DD evaluated at the five bulk/tail sub-pair temperatures.
